title: relation — edge in the causal graph between actors (living world)
description: The CAUSAL graph tells who DEPENDS ON whom (doc 04 §1, contract §6.3). Distinct from the spatial graph (adjacency). A relation is identified by the tuple (source_actor, vers, type); the 'id' field is optional (rel:<src>-<type>-<dst>). The 'delai_ut' encodes CAUSAL CONSERVATION (no instantaneous effects at a distance). 'poids' and 'delai_ut' drive bounded propagation (contract §8). This schema validates an ISOLATED relation and is reused by actor.schema.json ($defs.relation). Permissive (additionalProperties:true).

id.description: OPTIONAL identifier 'rel:<src-slug>-<type>-<dst-slug>' if the relation needs to be referenced.

vers.description: ID of the target actor or location (e.g. 'acteur:berthe', 'lieu:marche-aux-trois-rivieres/gue-du-corbeau').

type.description: Type of causal edge. Enum extensible per campaign; unknown (event_type, type) pairs have no propagation effect.

part.description: Fraction (0–1) of the flow that depends on this relation.

delai_ut.description: Propagation delay in UT (causal conservation): offset before the wave affects the target.

poids.description: Multiplicative propagation factor. Application default = intensite (or 0.5).
